tools.description: Recommends the insurance a general contractor should require of a subcontractor, or a property manager or HOA of a vendor: general liability, auto, umbrella and workers' comp limits, additional insured, waiver of subrogation and primary/non-contributory wording, scaled to the trade's risk and the contract size. Returns the reasoning for each limit, contract-ready exhibit text, and a requirements object that check_certificate accepts.

cancellationNoticeDays.description: Days of written notice before cancellation. 0 = as the policy provides.

context.description: "gc" = a contractor hiring a subcontractor; "property" = a property manager or HOA hiring a service vendor.

contractSize.description: Contract value band. For "gc": under-50k, 50k-250k, 250k-1m, over-1m. For "property": under-10k, 10k-50k, 50k-250k, over-250k. A band from the other context is mapped to the smallest valid one.

hasEmployees.description: false for a sole proprietor with no employees: workers' comp is replaced by a signed exemption declaration.

overrides.description: Optional dollar limits that replace the recommended ones, for lines that are already required.

trade.description: The vendor's trade, and the contexts it is offered in: "general" = General / multi-trade (gc); "carpentry" = Carpentry / framing (gc); "concrete" = Concrete / masonry (gc); "drywall" = Drywall / plaster (gc); "painting" = Painting / finishes (gc/property); "electrical" = Electrical (gc/property); "mechanical" = Plumbing / HVAC (gc/property); "glazing" = Glazing / curtain wall (gc); "roofing" = Roofing (gc/property); "demolition" = Demolition (gc); "steel" = Structural steel / crane work (gc); "excavation" = Excavation / earthwork (gc); "scaffolding" = Scaffolding / shoring (gc); "abatement" = Asbestos / lead abatement (gc); "designbuild" = Design-build / engineering (gc); "landscaping" = Landscaping / grounds (property/gc); "janitorial" = Janitorial / cleaning (property); "pool" = Pool maintenance (property); "pest" = Pest control (property); "snow" = Snow & ice removal (property); "tree" = Tree removal / arborist (property); "elevator" = Elevator maintenance (property); "security" = Security services (property); "pm" = Property management services (property).

usesVehicles.description: Drives to or around the site. false drops commercial auto.

tools.description: Checks a certificate of insurance (ACORD 25) against insurance requirements with CertifiKit's deterministic rules engine: coverage present, limits at or above the minimums, policies not expired or expiring too soon, and the required endorsements. Read the certificate yourself and pass what it shows; the verdict (pass, fail or needs_review) and a plain-English reason per requirement come from fixed rules, not a model. Anything unreported, unreadable or below 0.7 confidence is routed to needs_review, never silently passed. Use preset or the requirements object from build_insurance_requirements.

asOf.description: Date to check expiry against, yyyy-mm-dd. Defaults to today.

certificate.description: What the certificate shows. Report only what is printed; do not infer. Leave out rows the certificate does not have.

additionalInsured.description: Additional insured: from the ADDL INSD / SUBR WVD boxes, the description of operations, or an attached endorsement form.

confidence.description: How sure you are of this row, 0-1. Defaults to 1. Set it below 0.7 if the row was hard to read, so it is routed to needs_review instead of pass or fail.

formNumber.description: Endorsement form number if printed, e.g. CG 20 10.

autoLiability.description: The Automobile Liability row of the ACORD 25. Omit it if the certificate has no such row.

aggregate.description: General aggregate limit in whole dollars as printed (1000000 for $1,000,000). null if blank or unreadable.

confidence.description: How sure you are of this row, 0-1. Defaults to 1. Set it below 0.7 if the row was hard to read, so it is routed to needs_review instead of pass or fail.

eachOccurrence.description: Combined single limit in whole dollars as printed (1000000 for $1,000,000). null if blank or unreadable.

effectiveDate.description: Policy effective date, yyyy-mm-dd. null if blank or unreadable.

expirationDate.description: Policy expiration date, yyyy-mm-dd. null if blank or unreadable.

present.description: true only if the row has a policy number or limits filled in.

preset.description: "standard-subcontractor" = Typical GC requirements for a trade sub: GL $1M/$2M, auto $1M, workers' comp $1M, additional insured + waiver of subrogation. "property-vendor" = Common requirements for service vendors at managed properties: GL $1M/$2M, workers' comp $500K, additional insured.

requirements.description: Custom requirements, e.g. the requirements object returned by build_insurance_requirements. Takes precedence over preset.

minDaysUntilExpiry.description: Fail policies expiring within this many days. 0 = fail only expired ones.
